summary.en: URL shortening and analytics services awaiting production modernization and a public UI.
summary.pl: Usługi skracania URL i analityki oczekujące modernizacji produkcyjnej oraz publicznego UI.

current.en: Replace unsafe forwarded-header handling and split redirect/create/manage policies.
current.pl: Zastąpić niebezpieczne XFF i rozdzielić polityki redirect/create/manage.

next.en: Add UI, Linux database strategy, CI/CD, containers and public deployment.
next.pl: Dodać UI, bazę dla Linuxa, CI/CD, kontenery i wdrożenie.

title.en: Fix XFF, SSRF and endpoint policies
title.pl: Naprawić XFF, SSRF i polityki endpointów

tasks.evidence: The API has tests and an in-memory limiter, but trusts unsafe client identity and lacks cost-separated policies.

title.en: Bound and harden the analytics queue

tasks.evidence: Analytics needs bounded ingestion, backpressure and failure isolation.

title.en: Restore security, integration and load tests
title.pl: Przywrócić testy bezpieczeństwa, integracji i load

tasks.evidence: Tests exist in source but no workflow run verifies them on GitHub.

title.en: Move to main, CI and a ruleset
title.pl: Przejść na main, CI i ruleset

tasks.evidence: The default branch remains master and GitHub has no workflow or ruleset.
The repository lacks a public README/license baseline and target deployment documentation.

title.en: Build an accessible UI and production containers
title.pl: Zbudować dostępny UI i kontenery produkcyjne

tasks.evidence: No frontend, production container topology or deployment workflow is present.

title.en: Add immutable CI/CD, preflight and blue-green
title.pl: Dodać niezmienne CI/CD, preflight i blue-green

tasks.evidence: GHCR digests, OIDC deploy, stable routing and rollback do not exist.
The target DNS is absent and edge/proxy limits and monitoring are not configured.

title.en: Add favicon and public UI metadata
title.pl: Dodać favicon i metadane publicznego UI

tasks.evidence: No web frontend or favicon exists.

decisions.en: Redirect traffic must not share the low creation limit.
decisions.pl: Ruch przekierowań nie może dzielić niskiego limitu tworzenia.

decisions.en: Use trusted proxy middleware, SSRF/private-address validation and a bounded analytics worker.
decisions.pl: Użyć trusted proxy, ochrony SSRF/private IP i ograniczonego workera analityki.

decisions.en: The project follows the v2 standard profile: vps-web.
decisions.pl: Projekt podlega profilowi standardu v2: vps-web.

sources: audited source tree and git status
GitHub repository, Actions, rulesets and environments API
public DNS and HTTPS checks where applicable

notes.en: This is a substantial modernization rather than a simple containerization task.
notes.pl: To duża modernizacja, a nie tylko konteneryzacja.
